error.claude_unavailable: Claude Code usage details are unavailable. Check claude, jq, and curl.

settings.antigravity_model_details_desc: By default Antigravity groups known Gemini and Claude/OpenAI quotas, with unknown real models under Other Models. Enable this only for per-model troubleshooting.
settings.bar_window.description: Providers with more than one quota window (e.g. Claude's 5 hour and 7 day) always show the primary window in the DankBar. Choose a different window per provider — the dashboard keeps showing every window. "Highest" follows the most-constrained window; providers without the chosen window fall back to the primary.
settings.bar_window.label: DankBar usage window
settings.density.description: Comfortable keeps full previews. Compact reduces card height and visual detail.
settings.density.label: Dashboard density
settings.diagnostics_desc: Commands for validating the plugin-managed pipeline.
settings.hero.self_managed: Provider collection, health checks, refresh policy and rendering are managed by this plugin. No external aggregation tool is required.
settings.history_export_desc: Writes every recorded snapshot to your downloads folder. CSV opens in a spreadsheet; JSONL is the raw store.
settings.history_retention_desc: Snapshots kept per trim of the local usage history (sparklines and trends).
settings.informational_providers_desc: These providers expose no public read-only quota API. Their cards point to the official usage surface.
settings.language.description: UI language for this plugin. Auto follows system locale.
settings.language.label: Language
settings.logo_color_desc: One monochrome color for every provider logo in the dashboard and desktop notifications.
settings.notify.cooldown_desc: 0 alerts once per quota window. Other values update the same notification after that many minutes while usage stays high.
settings.notify.description: Alert once when a provider crosses the threshold, then update the same notification if its quota is exhausted.
settings.notify.label: Quota notifications
settings.notify.overrides_desc: Comma-separated provider:percent pairs that beat the global threshold.
settings.notify.overrides_error_duplicat: “{id}” is listed more than once — the last value wins.
settings.notify.overrides_error_empty: Empty entry — remove the stray comma.
settings.notify.overrides_error_percent: “{value}” is not a whole percentage between 1 and 100.
settings.notify.overrides_error_untracke: “{id}” is not a tracked provider, so it never alerts.
settings.notify.threshold_desc: Usage percent that triggers a notification.
settings.notify.window_scope_desc: “Displayed” alerts on whatever window the DankBar shows for each provider — identical to “Primary” until you override a provider above. “All windows” also alerts on Claude's 7 day, Codex's weekly, and every other secondary window.
settings.pill_mode.description: Auto shows providers with measurable usage. Custom uses the configured list.
settings.pill_mode.label: Pill mode
settings.pill_providers.description: Choose a compact subset of tracked providers. This only changes the DankBar pill; tracking and dashboard cards remain unchanged.
settings.pill_providers.label: Providers shown in DankBar
settings.pill_tooltip_desc: Hovering the bar pill spells out the provider, which quota window the percentage came from, and when it resets.
settings.refresh_description: How often the plugin queries selected local adapters and provider APIs.
settings.reset_confirm_desc: This restores every option on this page, including tracked providers, pins, notification thresholds, and DankBar overrides. Recorded usage history is kept.
settings.reset_desc: Restore every option on this page to its default. Recorded usage history is kept.
settings.show_errors_desc: Keep authentication and configuration failures visible in the dashboard.
settings.show_projects_desc: List the week's top projects inside the Claude card.
settings.telemetry_providers_desc: Adapters backed by official CLIs, documented APIs, or local usage stores.

status.no_data_hint: Authenticate the configured provider CLIs or API keys, then refresh.
status.no_provider_data: No provider data available. Check credentials and local provider CLIs.

provider.note.copilot: Authenticated Copilot quota from the GitHub session
provider.note.pi: Local session cost/token analytics — no quota API
provider.note.hermes: Dual-nature: agent harness telemetry (sessions, tokens, models, projects) from the local state database; provider side routes through Nous Portal / OpenRouter — expand the card for details
provider.note.antigravity: Per-model quota and reset times, one block per signed-in account / IDE — expand the card to compare accounts
provider.note.gemini: Authentication status; quota remains in AI Studio
provider.note.kimi: Account balance (USD/CNY), or Kimi Code subscription quota with a sk-kimi- key / KIMI_CODING_API_KEY
provider.note.minimax: Token Plan quota (5h + weekly) via MINIMAX_TOKEN_PLAN_KEY or sk-cp MINIMAX_API_KEY; pay-as-you-go keys use models API authentication
provider.note.commandcode: Uses COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY or the credential saved by cmd login. Reads /alpha/billing/credits for 5h/weekly/monthly quota; falls back to /provider/v1/models on alpha failure.
provider.note.glm: China (Zhipu) quota windows and plan; falls back to models authentication
provider.note.zai: Official quota windows and plan; falls back to models authentication
provider.note.nvidia: Configured-key status; the public models catalog cannot validate the key
provider.note.ollama: Official local tags and running-model APIs
provider.note.together: Read-only API-key validation; usage and billing remain in the console
provider.note.fireworks: API-key validation; FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID enables account quotas
provider.note.xai: Prefers grok login (~/.grok/auth.json) for SuperGrok weekly usage. XAI_API_KEY validates inference keys. Prepaid API credits need XAI_MANAGEMENT_KEY and XAI_TEAM_ID.
provider.note.kilo: Configured-key status; the no-auth models endpoint is only a best-effort probe
provider.note.ai21: Configured status; no documented read-only usage API
provider.note.opencode: Uses OPENCODE_API_KEY or the credential saved by `opencode auth login` to ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json. Reads OpenCode Zen's /zen/go/v1/usage for live 5h/weekly/monthly quota; shows when balance fallback is enabled; falls back to /zen/go/v1/models on failure.
